source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Each equipped Plasmacyte gives the unit one use per battle. You can activate it on selection to [fight](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), granting **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds)** to all its models’ melee weapons through phase end.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.target: melee weapons equipped by models in owning unit
